newsitem.title: FRANCE: CCF says Japan Gamma asset mgment merging.
newsitem.headline: CCF says Japan Gamma asset mgment merging.

text.p: French bank Credit Commercial de France (CFF) said on Wednesday asset management venture Japan Gamma was merging with Taiyo Life Capital Management, partly due to competition in a deregulating Japanese pension funds market.

It said CCF Asset Management Group had created Japan Gamma with New York Life and Taiyo Mutual Life in 1988 and that the three shareholders in Japan Gamma had agreed to merge it with Taiyo Life Capital Management, owned by Taiyo Mutual Life.
"The opening up and deregulation of of the Japanese pension fund market creates new opportunities and increasing competitive pressures," which led to the merger, CCF said in a statement.
